programs.title: Bamay
programs.sub_title: Western Australia Cape To Cape - Part 1
programs.desc: Exploring Cape Naturaliste National Park, where rugged cliffs meet the wild Indian Ocean. This episode captures the dramatic beauty of the Cape to Cape region and the enduring cultural ties of the Wadandi-Pibulmun people to this sacred coastline.

programs.title: Bamay
programs.sub_title: Western Australia Cape To Cape - Part 2
programs.desc: We journey through the famed Margaret River region, home to rolling vineyards, Karri forests, and powerful surf breaks, exploring the land's natural contrasts and deep Noongar stories held within it.

programs.title: Birds Eye View
